findings.title: Same-amount matching can attach an unrelated provider refund to a local attempt
findings.detail: FIXED. refundFor now requires an existing provider refund identity, the dispatch attempt's own response, or the platform refund reference; the amount-only fallback is removed. Unmatched refunds and conflicting provider identities create UNKNOWN_REFUND cases at lines 1308–1321, keyed by provider reference through migration 0019. The regression at apps/api/test/b09-review.test.ts:118 asserts the unrelated webhook leaves the local refund SUBMITTING, settlement records its own provider identity, and each unexplained refund retains a separate amount-bearing case. verify.log:676 records its pass.
findings.reproduction: Checked the original AFTER_CALL interleaving in apps/api/test/b09-review.test.ts:125: deliver a separate 1000-cent refund, then release settlement. Assertions at lines 137, 143 and 149 establish correct separation; lines 165–173 cover conflicting identities and repeated delivery.

findings.title: A reversal observed before its completed refund double-counts returned money
findings.detail: FIXED. Refund completion reads the capture status under a row lock and publishes zero additional returned components and zero movable balance after reversal. Approved refund components remain intact. packages/application/src/commerce/core/postings.ts:118 consumes the returned components. The regression at apps/api/test/b09-review.test.ts:226 checks three observation orders, with and without a retained fee, against actual ledger balances and event totals. verify.log:677 records its pass.
findings.reproduction: Checked the original 97125-cent capture and 1000-cent refund under ONE_QUERY and REVERSAL_THEN_REFUND, plus REFUND_THEN_REVERSAL as a control. Assertions at apps/api/test/b09-review.test.ts:233 and :239 require the capture to be returned exactly once; event delivery permutations are checked at line 241.

findings.title: An earlier refund prevents the watchdog from resolving a later no-effect attempt
findings.detail: FIXED. Absence checks now match each refund by provider refund identity or platform refund reference, rather than capture identity. An unrelated earlier refund no longer suppresses provedNoEffect. apps/api/test/b09-review.test.ts:286 exercises both a timeout without effect and a crash after claim before dispatch while an earlier completed refund remains visible. verify.log:679 records its pass.
findings.reproduction: The regression advances the provider/service clocks beyond both deadlines and calls watchAttempt repeatedly at apps/api/test/b09-review.test.ts:313. Assertions at lines 318–322 require both later attempts FAILED_NO_EFFECT, their refunds APPROVED, the earlier refund unchanged, and no new provider effect.

findings.title: Provider fees learned with or after reversal are silently discarded
findings.detail: FIXED. Fee learning now applies to COMPLETED and REVERSED captures. The fee event uses zero movable balance after reversal, also enforced by packages/persistence/src/repositories/commerce-captures.ts:370, so the retained fee is charged to the merchant's available balance. apps/api/test/b09-review.test.ts:248 verifies fees received with reversal, after reversal, and through a reversal webhook, including duplicate suppression and ledger balances. verify.log:678 records its pass.
findings.reproduction: Checked the original 5275-cent late-fee scenarios. Assertions at apps/api/test/b09-review.test.ts:258–270 require the durable fee and its event; line 279 requires PROCESSOR_EXPENSE 5275 and PSP_AVAILABLE -5275 after the capture is returned.

findings.title: Three advertised foreign-tenant denial checks use no foreign-tenant resource
findings.detail: FIXED. CMD032 now creates another agency's real refund, compares unauthorized access with an unknown identifier, and tests cross-scope reads, approval and scope adoption at lines 170–195. CMD033 creates a real foreign approved refund and checks read, lock, transition and scope-adoption refusals at apps/api/test/cmd033-execute-refund.test.ts:95–120. CMD034 rejects a foreign stored query through the route and tests the reconciler against an actual foreign order under the adopted scope at apps/api/test/cmd034-reconcile-payment.test.ts:95–129. Each verifies unchanged foreign state. verify.log:774, :778 and :781 record passes.
findings.reproduction: Traced the foreign fixtures to agency B and inspected the actual foreign refund/order identifiers used in the cross-scope assertions. These controls now exercise existing foreign resources, independently of the retained wrong-kind and nonexistent-ID checks.
